title: Guard one real instant of remembrance
summary: One moment of true remembrance steadies more than endless drift. Guard one whole instant as if it were a long life.
takeaway: Guard one whole instant as if it were a long life.
lifeApplication: Before the next anxious leap, give one undivided instant to remembrance and let it steady more than the whole drift.

source.shortMeaning: One moment of true remembrance steadies more than endless drift.
source.lifeApplication: Break the drift with one whole instant of remembrance before moving again.
